description: This file defines interfaces, classes, and attributes related to fault injection and transactional state management within the Orleans framework, specifically for testing purposes. It includes a custom attribute for fault injection configuration, a factory for creating transactional state instances with fault injection capabilities, and a mapper to convert attributes to factory methods.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttribute
classes.description: Custom attribute used to specify fault injection transactional state configuration, including state and storage names.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating instances of fault-injected transactional state objects.

classes.name: FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttributeMapper
classes.description: Mapper class that converts FaultInjectionTransactionalStateAttribute instances into factory functions for dependency injection.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a fault-injected transactional state instance for a given generic type, using the provided configuration.

methods.name: GetFactory
methods.description: Generates a factory function based on the attribute and method info, to produce transactional state instances.

methods.name: Create (private)
methods.description: Helper method to invoke the factory method with the appropriate context and arguments.
